title: Command-o-fun
description: A Bunch of fun and partly useful commands!
body:
A couple of useful and silly little commands.

**Useful Commands (15)**

    /fly [player]: Toggles survival flight for yourself or others.
    /velocity <player> <x> <y> <z>: Adds a specific amount of "push" in any direction.
    /heal [player]: Instantly restores full health.
    /feed [player]: Instantly restores full hunger and saturation.
    /god [player]: Makes a player completely invulnerable.
    /repair: Fixes the durability of the item you are currently holding.
    /top: Teleports you to the very highest block above your current position.
    /nightvision [player]: Toggles infinite night vision.
    /speed <1-10> [player]: Changes walking speed (opposite FOV).
    /rename <name>: Renames the item in your hand to anything (supports spaces!).
    /extinguish [player]: Instantly puts a player out if they are on fire.
    /tpall: Teleports every single player on the server to your location.
    /back: Teleports you back to your previous location (works after deaths/warps).
    /flyspeed <1-10>: Changes how fast you fly.
    /stacksize: Increases the item stack in your hand to a full 64.

 

 

**Silly Commands (17)**

    /judge <player>: 50/50 chance to ascend to the heavens or be buried alive underground!
    /anvil <player>: Summons a falling anvil directly above their head.
    /lightning <player>: Strikes the player with a bolt of lightning.
    /yeet <player>: Launches a player so high they disappear.
    /confuse <player>: Flips their view and adds Nausea/Slowness.
    /fakeop <player>: Sends them a fake system message saying they are now an Operator.
    /tnt <player>: Spawns a primed, ticking TNT at their feet.
    /swap <player1> <player2>: Swaps the positions of two players instantly.
    /creep <player>: Spawns a creeper directly behind the target.
    /pumpkin [player]: Forces a Cursed Pumpkin (Binding) onto their head.
    /rocket [player]: Launches the player up with a trail of explosions.
    /freeze [player]: Stops a player from moving but jumps super high.
    /shuffle [player]: Scrambles every single item in their inventory.
    /spam <player> <count> <message>: Sends the same message to them up to 50 times.
    /slap <player>: "Slaps" them into the air with a red message in their chat.
    /blind [player]: Toggles total, infinite blindness for a player.
    /fakeban <player>: Kicks the player with a very realistic permanent ban screen.
